description: Central Environmental Authority - Amendment to the Order published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1887/20 of 05.11.2014
reasoning: This gazette content is a correction notice issued by the Central Environmental Authority to amend errors in a previously published gazette. It specifically corrects terminology related to vehicle types ("Tricyles" to "Tricycles" and "Diesal Vehicles" to "Diesel Vehicles"). This constitutes a legal/regulatory amendment to existing published regulations, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) which includes "Legal amendments, repeals, or modifications" and "Regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements." While a minister's name appears, it is only in the signature block and does not involve government personnel changes or portfolio descriptions that would trigger Types 1-3.
